text.en:
Section nine of Presidential Decree No. 995 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"SEC. 9. Appropriations. - To meet the organizational as well as other expenses of the Batasan Bayan, the
amount of Two Million Pesos is hereby appropriated out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise
appropriated. Thereafter, such sum as may be necessary for the purpose shall be included in the annual
General Appropriations Decree."

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 22nd day of September in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-six.
